type: Explicit post-freeze input-validation correction; not a new pre-test freeze
before: Python rejected some exact 0.01-percentage-point WACC spreads because floating subtraction fell below 0.0001. Reproduced at terminal growth 1%, 2% and 3%.
correction: Allow eight machine-epsilon units scaled to the rate magnitudes in the validation comparison only. Financial cash flows, discounting and solver code are unchanged.
integrity_policy: Original freeze retained. The preserved original must match its original SHA-256; the exact revised method and readable patch must match the explicit revision hashes. Other frozen methods and original tests remain unchanged.
additional_counterexample: Mixed ROIC/WACC can make policy value nonmonotone. A 30-year synthetic case has values above target at growth 0 and 0.25 but below target inside the bracket. Endpoint signs alone do not prove unreachability.
reverse_status_correction: Preserve unreachable status only when nonnegative growth and same-side ROIC/WACC prove monotonicity (or EBIT is zero). Otherwise return not_bracketed. No exhaustive root search or unique-root claim.
finite_numeric_guards: Reject overflow/nonfinite outputs and residuals. Compare residual signs directly rather than multiplying, which can underflow for tiny finite anchors.
